# E0209: a version under history/ has an error

A version under history/ was cut from the tip, and cutting binds the whole
lineage, so it had no error then. A version under history/ never changes once
cut: an error in one means that its file, another file under history/, or thema
has changed since. Each error in the file follows, without its help, since any
fix it could suggest edits a file that never changes; the change belongs in
tip.thema. Here, the ForwardLens of v1.0 reads a field v0.0 does not declare,
and maps nothing from the field v0.0 does declare.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	b: string
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		b: v0_0.nope
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	b: string
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0209]: immutability violation: v1.0 is under history/, and has 2 errors
 --> history/1.0.thema:1:1
  |
1 | Schema: {
  | ^^^^^^
  |
  = note: a version under history/ never changes once it is cut, and had no error when it was cut, so since then its file, another file under history/, or thema has changed
  = help: find which file under history/ changed since it was cut, restore it, and make the change in tip.thema

error[E0340]: v0.0 does not declare nope
 --> history/1.0.thema:8:6
  |
8 |         b: v0_0.nope
  |            ^^^^
  |

error[E0347]: v0.0 declares a and v1.0 does not, and nothing maps it
 --> history/1.0.thema:5:1
  |
5 | ForwardLens: {
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^
  |
```
